title: CI Diagnose Agent Result
description: Structured output from the ci-diagnose agent. Diagnoses failing PR checks (GitHub Actions + OpenShift CI/Prow), classifies each, and renders the sticky PR comment the post-script upserts.

pr_number.description: The pull request number the failures belong to.

head_sha.description: The PR head commit SHA that was analyzed (as read at agent runtime, not from the trigger event).

verdict.description: Overall rollup verdict across all failing checks. Use 'mixed' when checks fall into more than one classification.

summary.description: One-to-three sentence human-readable bottom line (e.g. 'Likely caused by this PR — both red checks touch workspaces/scorecard').

checks.description: One entry per currently-red curated check that was diagnosed.

comment_body.description: Fully rendered markdown for the sticky PR comment. MUST contain the sticky marker '<!-- ci-diagnose -->' and the state marker '<!-- ci-diagnose-state: {"sha":...,"red":[...]} -->' so the bootstrap can dedup.

name.description: Exact check name / status context (e.g. 'ci/prow/e2e-ocp-helm', 'appConfigExamples coverage').

type.description: prow = OpenShift CI StatusContext; gha_check = GitHub Actions CheckRun; status = comment-command StatusContext (publish/smoketest).

root_cause.description: The failure MECHANISM, not the symptom. 'Timeout' is a symptom; explain why it timed out.

evidence.description: Key log lines, trace findings, or diff correlation supporting the classification.

suggestion.description: Concrete next step (specific file/line to change, or 're-run — transient', or 'not this PR').

log_url.description: Direct link to logs (gcsweb for Prow, Actions run for GH Actions).
